purpose: Record the shared command helper reduction plan before any physical command family package split.
policy: The shared command family remains blocked until output, JSON envelope, root wiring, path flag, and template source helper boundaries are reduced through adapter dry-runs with stable CLI and JSON contracts.

reductionDomains.currentCoupling: Global command IO state, output mode parsing, quiet/verbose behavior, and stdout/stderr helpers are shared by most command families.
reductionDomains.targetBoundary: Introduce a small command output adapter that can be passed to help and doctor without moving global IO state.
reductionDomains.firstAction: Add an output adapter dry-run that preserves current withCommandIO, output mode, quiet, verbose, stdout, and stderr behavior.

reductionDomains.currentCoupling: JSON success envelopes, JSON error classification, writer behavior, and command error exit semantics are shared across release, doctor, plugin, RPC, and AI commands.
reductionDomains.targetBoundary: Separate JSON envelope rendering from command family code while preserving stable JSON fields and stdout-only output.
reductionDomains.firstAction: Add a JSON adapter dry-run that pins printJSON, printJSONEnvelope, printJSONError, and WriteErrorJSON behavior before extraction.

reductionDomains.currentCoupling: Root command execution, command registry dispatch, global controls, and command argument parsing still sit in shared files used by every command family.
reductionDomains.targetBoundary: Keep root wiring in the command package until family adapters are proven and command registration metadata is stable.
reductionDomains.firstAction: Document root wiring as a non-move boundary and add adapter seams only after output and JSON adapters pass.

reductionDomains.currentCoupling: Output path, API file, IDL file, file input, and dry-run flag helpers are shared by generation, RPC, API, model, and template commands.
reductionDomains.targetBoundary: Group path and dry-run flag helpers behind explicit generator-facing adapters before moving command families.
reductionDomains.firstAction: Keep path helpers shared while adding focused tests before any generator-facing family extraction.

reductionDomains.currentCoupling: Template source flags, template filtering, and template management commands are shared by project templates, RPC templates, AI project templates, and generated scaffold paths.
reductionDomains.targetBoundary: Keep template source helpers shared until template trust and generated-output gates prove adapter behavior.
reductionDomains.firstAction: Create a template source adapter plan after output and JSON dry-runs are stable, with generated-output determinism gates attached.

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Perform an output and JSON adapter dry-run before moving help, doctor, or shared helpers into another package.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore shared helper files to the current cmd/gofly/internal/command layout if output mode, JSON fields, root dispatch, path flags, template behavior, or CLI surface gates regress.
